title: Semantic-Eval Labeled Fixture Set (C1 calibration)
description: Governed labeled evaluation set of correct and deliberately-wrong-but-resolving (GherkinScenario)->(ApiOperation) pairs (FR-81). Marked fixture_kind 'semantic-eval' and EXCLUDED from the byte-parity / dual-runtime fixture set: it is never consumed by a parity test. Each pair carries a ground-truth label plus provenance; the quality gate (Cohen's kappa >= threshold, class balance, adversarial hard-negatives, full adjudication) is enforced by the Story 11.2 harness predicates against the checked-in kappa manifest, adjudication log, and hard-negative manifest. snake_case at the wire boundary.

fixture_kind.description: Marks the set as semantic-eval so the byte-parity / dual-runtime fixture loader never discovers it (FR-81 AC1).

reference_type.description: The reference-type rule id whose enumeration granularity the set is aligned to (FR-81 AC3).

status.description: 'awaiting-calibration' until real >=2-rater labels + Cohen's kappa + full adjudication land; only then does the full FR-81 quality gate enforce.

candidate_provenance.description: Source of the candidate pairs. A verdict-derived source is FORBIDDEN (closes the B2 thaw side-door): candidate pairs may never be sourced from disposition-inferred verdict data.

labeled_pair.description: One labeled unit, keyed by exactly one (source_spec_id, target_spec_id) pair (FR-81 AC5). The judged target varies per reference type: exactly one of 'api_op' (gherkin-scenario-has-api-backing) or 'acceptance_criterion' (acceptance-criterion-has-scenario-coverage) is present (oneOf). Both target objects are declared under 'properties' so additionalProperties:false admits whichever the oneOf selects (Draft 2020-12: additionalProperties only sees same-object properties, not oneOf subschemas).

labeler_ids.description: Independent rater ids. The >=2-rater requirement (FR-81 AC4) is enforced by the harness predicate, not the schema, so the awaiting-calibration seed validates structurally.

real_target_ref.description: For a wrong (hollow) pair: the operation the scenario actually backs, recorded for adjudication review.

acceptance_criterion.description: The judged target for the acceptance-criterion-has-scenario-coverage reference type: the criterion's own id/text plus its parent requirement's id/title (the D3 requirement-general haystack context).

kappa_threshold.description: Cohen's kappa acceptance threshold. A provisional, per-corpus and per-model-calibrated target (FR-81 AC7). This 'default' keyword is the single documented home for the value: no source constant carries it; configuration overrides via sdd.config.yaml semantic.kappa_threshold.

kappa_manifest.description: Checked-in inter-rater artifact. Each pair is independently rated; Cohen's kappa is computed over the per-rater labels before admission (FR-81 AC4).

adjudication_log.description: Checked-in adjudication artifact. Every rater disagreement is adjudicated to full consensus with zero residual before admission (FR-81 AC5).

hard_negative_manifest.description: Checked-in adversarial artifact (FR-81 AC3, SC-19). Lists the wrong-but-resolving lexically-overlapping predicate-gaming bait pairs. CI counts them; genuine semantic hardness is human-judgment-bound.

precision_report.description: Committed FAIL-class precision calibration for one reference type (FR-82, Story 11.7): the recorded per-model verdict maps over the governed C1 set, from which the runtime precision gate derives its PrecisionReport. fixture_kind 'semantic-eval-precision' keeps it out of the byte-parity / dual-runtime fixture set. snake_case at the wire boundary.

fixture_kind.description: Marks the file as a semantic-eval precision calibration so the byte-parity / dual-runtime fixture loader never discovers it.

precision_report_model.description: One model's recorded verdict map over the C1 set. Precision is published PER model_id (NFR-34 provider variance).

source_set_hash.description: frozen_C1_hash of the set the verdicts were measured over; a mismatch against the current set voids the calibration (drift guard, NFR-34).

precision_verdict_entry.description: The lane's PASS|FAIL verdict for one (source_spec_id, target_spec_id) pair in the C1 set.
